title: PatientConsentUpdated
description: A patient or visitor granted or withdrew a consent purpose. The payload carries an opaque subject reference only: no name, phone, email or health data. Append-only history; the latest row wins; withdrawal is effective for the send gate within 60 seconds.

subRef.description: Opaque reference to the subject used internally; never the Passport sub of a partner-visible patient.

purpose.description: ANALYTICS_MEASUREMENT, MARKETING_WHATSAPP, MARKETING_SMS, MARKETING_EMAIL, MARKETING_PUSH or a purpose added later.

channel.description: Optional channel when the purpose is channel-specific.

textVersion.description: Id of the exact approved wording (AR and EN) shown to the person. Placeholder until counsel approves.

aggregateType.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.

aggregateId.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.
